The big report now prints totals to two decimals, and the fix is committed as `5b841b6` on `main`.

**Cause:** "The big report" maps to `QuarterlyExport` in `INDEX.md`. Its `to_csv` wrote the raw float sum, so 0.1 + 0.2 came out as `0.30000000000000004`.

**Fix:** The total is now formatted with `:.2f`, the same as `csv_export.py`. I also added a regression test that prices `[0.1, 0.2]` must print `0.30`.

**Verified:**
- The new test fails on the old code with `0.30000000000000004`, and passes with the fix.
- The full suite passes with the fix (9 tests). Run with all three `src` folders on the path, because the default run can't import them.

**Behaviour change:** Whole-number totals now print with two decimals too, so `15` becomes `15.00`. That matches `csv_export.py`, but any consumer that expects `15` will see a difference.

**Not touched:** `README.md` (modified) and `notes/` (untracked) were already in the working tree, and I left them unstaged. The commit contains only `src/orders-web/quarterly_export.py` and `tests/test_orders_web.py`.

I did not run the repo's `docs/` checks or the eval. The change touches no playbook or `AGENTS.md` text, so I don't think either applies.
